REPORT OWNER WORKFLOW

👥 Teacher Collaboration

Create a restricted subject-teacher workspace that contains only the information needed to contribute to report cards. The contributor does not receive the rest of your planner.

🔐 Homeroom Teacher / Report Owner
✓ Contributor can access Selected class student names, each assigned subject's grades, scanned-test upload/replace, subject rubric ratings, subject Teacher Notes and the subject report comment.
✕ Contributor cannot access Attendance, parent/guardian details, student additional information, other subjects, Homeroom comments, Lessons, Planning, Tasks, Meetings, Contacts, Settings or your OneDrive configuration.
Data-isolated collaboration: the downloaded contributor HTML physically contains only the assigned class/subject/report fields. This is safer than simply hiding planner tabs. It is a file-based contributor workflow for the current single-file planner; live Microsoft school-account invitations require a hosted app/Entra setup.

👤 Planner Identity & Sharing

Teacher Name
Change this before sharing the planner. It updates the sidebar, dashboard greeting, browser-tab title and backup filename.
Language
Translate the planner interface. Your own lesson content, student names, notes and imported curriculum stay unchanged.
Decorations Enabled
Turn this off for a cleaner, more formal planner. Professional layout also hides decorative elements.
Quick Professional Look
Applies Professional Navy, structured layout, navy accents, no decorations and no animations.
Reset Appearance
Return only the visual settings to the default Soft Floral look.

✨ AI Lesson Planning

Secure setup: the planner never stores an OpenAI API key in the HTML or browser. For one-click generation, enter a secure server/proxy endpoint below. Without an endpoint, you can still use Copy Prompt → ChatGPT → Import Response.
Optional Local AI Gateway (recommended for scanned tests)
Configure this once and the planner can automatically inspect every stored assessment scan for the selected student and term. Teachers do not need to find or re-upload the tests in ChatGPT. The OpenAI API key stays on the gateway/server — never inside this HTML file.
This token is kept only for the current browser session. It is not included in planner backups or OneDrive sync.

SOFTWARE

🔄 About & Updates

Version
Your planner app and your teacher data are separate. When you receive a newer HTML file, open the new file and reconnect the same Teacher Planner Sync folder. Your classes, students, lessons, planning, attendance and attachments will be loaded into the new version.
1Open the new Teacher Planner HTML file.
2Choose Connect Existing Planner Data.
3Select the same Teacher Planner Sync folder.
Safety rule: this restore button never writes an empty planner into the folder. It only loads data when a valid planner-data.json is found.

☁️ OneDrive Folder Sync

Select a dedicated folder inside your local OneDrive folder. The planner now saves everyday information to a small planner-data.json file, so Planning Hub edits, notes, completion ticks, grades and attendance sync quickly instead of rebuilding a large ZIP after every change.
Recommended setup Create a folder in OneDrive called Teacher Planner Sync. Select that same synced folder once on your laptop and once on your desktop. After that, normal planner changes are saved automatically.
No OneDrive sync folder linked on this computer.
⚠️ Both computers have unsynchronised changes. Choose which version should become the master copy.
What now syncs immediately: Planning Hub units/topics, weekly and yearly completion, Planning notes/coverage, student lists, attendance, grades, homework, lessons, calendar information, tasks and saved notes. Attachments and scanned tests are stored as separate files inside the same OneDrive sync folder and are copied only when they change.
Important: OneDrive itself still needs time to upload/download the files between computers. The planner checks for the arriving planner-data.json update every few seconds. Avoid actively editing the planner on both computers at exactly the same time.
Portable full-package backup
You can still create/import a complete ZIP backup if needed. You do not need to extract it.

💾 Planner Backup
